query:
insert into vedaflow_refs (tenant_id, scope_id, name, commit_hash, updated_by)
         values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
         on conflict (tenant_id, scope_id, name)
         do update set commit_hash = excluded.commit_hash,
                       updated_at = now(),
                       updated_by = excluded.updated_by
